title: WF03 Stage11 cycle3 rework2: XC-04 deterministic path and Stage11 aggregate telemetry stabilization
summary: Added focused XC-04 integration execution and Stage11 SIM+XC aggregate execution targets, fixed TC-XC-04-03 crash-prone query pattern/tenant fixture, and stabilized TC-SIM-01-01 assertion to validate JSON value semantics rather than formatting-sensitive string layout.

root_cause.details: TC-XC-04-03 used overlapping active query result lifetimes on a single connection and unstable tenant fixture assumptions, while TC-SIM-01-01 depended on exact JSON text formatting / pointer-equality semantics instead of field-value validation.

changes: Added build target test-integration-xc04 for deterministic focused XC-04 execution.
Added build target test-integration-stage11-sim-xc04 for narrow aggregate SIM-01..SIM-04 + XC-04 verification.
Updated TC-XC-04-03 to use deterministic default tenant id and non-overlapping query lifetimes.
Updated TC-SIM-01-01 assertion to parse payload JSON and compare semantic field value.

prevention: Use focused integration targets for deterministic diagnosis before aggregate reruns.
Avoid pointer-equality expectations for JSON string values in tests; compare semantic values.
